candidate.verified_factual_summary: In the saved Google results for 'aviator', hollywoodbets.net ranked #2 and betway.co.za ranked #1. betway.co.za leads by 1 position in this snapshot. This is one recorded search, not evidence of a sustained trend or why the positions differ. Largest Contentful Paint: tracked 24.9s, benchmark 19.5s. Total Blocking Time: tracked 2.1s, benchmark 3.3s.

verified_factual_findings.statement: Saved Google result: hollywoodbets.net is #2 and betway.co.za is #1 for 'aviator'.
verified_factual_findings.interpretation: betway.co.za leads by 1 position in this snapshot. The result confirms a visibility difference for this captured query and market only.
verified_factual_findings.why_it_matters: The higher-listed result is encountered earlier on this search-results page, giving the benchmark greater visibility in this snapshot.
verified_factual_findings.next_check: Repeat the same query with the same market and device context over multiple dates; compare the exact ranking URLs before treating the gap as persistent.
verified_factual_findings.limitation: A single saved SERP is not a trend. Rankings vary, and this comparison does not identify a cause.

verified_factual_findings.statement: The captured HTML title for the tracked ranking page does not include 'aviator'; the benchmark title includes it.
verified_factual_findings.interpretation: This is a difference in the page title text captured by the crawler. Google may rewrite the title shown in results, so the HTML title and visible search-result title are related but not always identical.
verified_factual_findings.why_it_matters: A clear, accurate title can help search engines and people understand what the page is about. Keyword presence by itself is not a ranking recipe.
verified_factual_findings.next_check: Open both cited ranking URLs, verify their current rendered title tags and Google result titles, then assess whether the tracked title accurately matches the page and search intent before proposing an edit.
verified_factual_findings.limitation: The snapshot establishes title wording only. It does not prove that title wording caused the position gap or that adding the keyword would improve ranking or clicks.

verified_factual_findings.statement: The crawler counted 9 internal links on the tracked page and 28 on the benchmark page (benchmark page: 19 more).
verified_factual_findings.interpretation: This is a count of links detected in the captured pages. More links do not automatically mean better internal linking; their destinations, anchor wording, placement, and usefulness matter.
verified_factual_findings.why_it_matters: Relevant internal links can help visitors move through a site and help crawlers discover related pages. A raw total cannot tell whether those links meaningfully support the selected ranking page.
verified_factual_findings.next_check: Review the captured link lists and compare unique, relevant links pointing to each exact ranking URL. Separate repeated navigation/footer links from contextual links before deciding whether there is a useful gap.
verified_factual_findings.limitation: A page-level count is not link density or quality, may include repeated site-wide links, and does not establish ranking causation.

verified_factual_findings.statement: Largest Contentful Paint: tracked page 24.9s vs benchmark 19.5s. The tracked page was about 5.4 seconds slower in this lab run.
verified_factual_findings.interpretation: LCP estimates when the main visible content finished appearing during this test. A longer time is a reason to investigate loading experience, not proof of a specific technical cause.
verified_factual_findings.why_it_matters: If repeated under comparable conditions and reflected in real-user data, slow visible loading can be a user-experience concern. This measurement alone cannot show how visitors experienced the page.
verified_factual_findings.next_check: Repeat several mobile Lighthouse runs with the same settings, identify the LCP element and its loading dependencies, and compare with real-user Core Web Vitals if available.
verified_factual_findings.limitation: These are single-run synthetic Lighthouse measurements, not field data. Device/network conditions affect results; the metric does not identify a root cause or prove a ranking effect.

verified_factual_findings.statement: Total Blocking Time: tracked page 2.1s vs benchmark 3.3s. The tracked page was about 1.2 seconds faster in this lab run.
verified_factual_findings.interpretation: TBT estimates how much long-running main-thread work delayed interaction during this lab test. Lower is better; it is distinct from LCP and does not describe the whole page experience.
verified_factual_findings.why_it_matters: A high or worsening TBT can make a page feel less responsive. Read it alongside LCP and other measures rather than treating one metric as an overall performance score.
verified_factual_findings.next_check: Repeat comparable mobile Lighthouse runs and inspect the long tasks shown in the diagnostic report; confirm any proposed fix improves responsiveness without harming loading.
verified_factual_findings.limitation: These are single-run synthetic Lighthouse measurements, not field data. Device/network conditions affect results; the metric does not identify a root cause or prove a ranking effect.

verified_factual_findings.statement: Page-specific third-party backlink rank favors betway.co.za (18 tracked versus 36 benchmark).
verified_factual_findings.interpretation: This is a third-party index score for the two ranking URLs. It is not a Google position; a larger score is stronger only within this provider metric.
verified_factual_findings.why_it_matters: Links from relevant, trusted pages can contribute to discovery and authority, but this aggregate score does not reveal which referring links are valuable.
verified_factual_findings.next_check: Compare the referring domains and linking pages for these exact URLs, confirm the links are live and relevant, and investigate unusual or low-quality patterns before proposing outreach.
verified_factual_findings.limitation: Provider index scores are estimates. Individual link quality, relevance, freshness, and any ranking effect are unverified.

verified_factual_findings.statement: Domain-wide third-party backlink rank favors hollywoodbets.net (70 tracked versus 65 benchmark).
verified_factual_findings.interpretation: This describes the provider’s estimate for each whole domain, not the selected ranking pages.
verified_factual_findings.why_it_matters: Domain-level link profiles provide broad competitive context, but they cannot explain a page-versus-page ranking difference on their own.
verified_factual_findings.next_check: Use the page-level backlink evidence for the ranking URLs and inspect the strongest relevant referring pages; keep domain and page findings separate.
verified_factual_findings.limitation: Third-party index score, not Google rank. Domain-wide metrics cannot be attributed to either exact ranking page or to ranking causation.

verified_factual_findings.statement: In the saved related-keyword set, the tracked domain leads on 24 shared queries and the benchmark leads on 31.
verified_factual_findings.interpretation: These are counts of queries where each domain leads, not average ranking positions or traffic totals.
verified_factual_findings.why_it_matters: The split offers broader context about which site appears to lead across the measured query set; it does not measure the value of each query to the business.
verified_factual_findings.next_check: Review the actual query list, search volumes, intent, and ranking URLs, then prioritize queries that match the business objective.
verified_factual_findings.limitation: Domain-level context only. Different URLs may rank, and the counts do not prove page-level relevance, traffic, or causation.
